result.note: Tests the concrete assurances on fertiliser supply and the size of the India–Russia trade deficit, both stated in the story.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar met Russian President Vladimir Putin. Consider the following statements:
items: Putin assured India that Russia would increase fertiliser shipments amid disruptions in West Asia.
India's bilateral trade deficit with Russia exceeded USD 50 billion in 2025–26.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Putin promised to sustain energy supplies and step up fertiliser shipments, and Jaishankar pressed Moscow to narrow a deficit that topped USD 50 billion in 2025–26. India sought better market access, payment mechanisms and business ties to close the gap.
questions.source: Jaishankar meanwhile pressed Russia to narrow a bilateral trade deficit that exceeded USD 50 billion in 2025–26, calling for better market access, payment mechanisms and business ties.
